items.title: Is Berkshire’s Bigger Bet on Delta (DAL) Altering The Investment Case For The Airline?
items.summary: In recent filings, Berkshire Hathaway disclosed that it added millions of Delta Air Lines shares while also reshaping its broader equity portfolio, including exiting Constellation Brands and trimming its Bank of America stake. This increased exposure places Delta alongside Berkshire’s core holdings such as Apple, American Express, Alphabet, Coca-Cola, and Bank of America, highlighting the airline’s importance within a highly concentrated investment lineup.
